correctness.rationale: The periodic Riccati positive fixed point exists analytically near zero amplitude by derivative -2s; two explicit variational equations yield a verified closed coefficient. Its harmonic maximum is unique by H>0 and its sign boundary has exact discriminant r²(4s²+omega²). Half-period translation forces even powers, a direct commutation proves the equal-removal exact case, and 202 independent numerical and analytic checker assertions passed. All statements restricted to small amplitude and linear infection.

value.rationale: The exactly independently seasonal two-direction host–vector setting is motivated by published transmission model comparisons. A unique removal-contrast-dependent phase optimizer and explicit opposite-sign invasion behavior at unchanged annual means and amplitudes address a structural model-design gap, with complete exact domain and meaningful biological interpretation but no overclaim about field efficacy.
